title: SPI-Math Source Record
description: Provenance and rights record for a single uploaded or derived source file. One record per file. Source records are the audit trail that links every curriculum objective and question item back to evidence. Never modify source files; this record describes them.

sourceId.description: Stable, opaque identifier independent of filename. Format: SRC- followed by a short base32/hex token.

originalPath.description: Original path of the file as uploaded, including parent archive path if nested (e.g. 'Primary School.zip/Grade 4/g4-ch01.html'). Preserved verbatim.

hash.description: Content hash for duplicate and revision detection. Omitted if the environment could not compute it.

rightsStatus.description: Copyright / usage classification. Drives whether content may be reused.

apparentOwnerOrPublisher.description: Best-effort publisher or owner (e.g. 'Oxford University Press', 'SPI-Math'). 'unknown' if not determinable.

confidential.description: All uploaded curriculum/internal documents are confidential project information by default.

level.description: Education level this source belongs to.

course.description: Course/programme label if applicable (e.g. 'IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL', 'Grade 4').

strand.description: Strand within the domain, if identifiable.

chapterOrUnit.description: Chapter / unit / module identifier within the source.

contains.description: Presence flags for content types, used by the coverage report.

language.description: Primary language. The platform is English-only; non-English sources are flagged here.

duplicationStatus.description: Duplicate / revision relationship detected via hash or naming.

duplicateOf.description: sourceId of the canonical/original record when duplicationStatus is duplicate / revision-of / superseded-by.

ocrUsed.description: True if any text was obtained via OCR; such text must be labelled uncertain.

qualityNotes.description: Free-text notes on quality, completeness, or issues.

addedInBatch.description: Identifier of the upload batch in which this source first appeared (for the living manifest).

firstSeen.description: Date this source first entered the manifest.

examples.course: IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL
examples.qualityNotes: Complete investigation solutions and chapter test references. Reference only; do not reproduce verbatim.
